ReadingList: PASSED — 6 of 6

  st-001  MET       governed_gate full: PASS, return_code 0, stdout shows all dots with no failures; bin/test.sh:1-13 is a POSIX sh script that runs `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` and exits with its status; probe: n/a, pinned by the green governed gate
  st-002  MET       app_server/books_views.py:23-30 POST /books calls add_book and returns 201 with id, title, author; probe: POST /books {Dune, Herbert} returned 201 with id 1; GET /books then returned it; app_server/templates/reading_list.html: on status 201 the script calls loadBooks(), which fetches /books and renders each entry
  st-003  MET       app_server/books_service.py:list_books sorts by id, the order added; probe: GET /books after adds returned ids 1, 2, 3 in order; probe: after DELETE of id 2, GET /books returned ids 1, 3 in order
  st-004  MET       app_server/books_views.py:33-38 DELETE returns 204 on success; probe: DELETE /books/2 returned 204; following GET /books omitted id 2; probe: a second DELETE /books/2 returned 404, leaving the list unchanged
  st-005  MET       app_server/books_service.py:_required raises InvalidBook for empty or whitespace-only values; probe: POST with title '  ' returned 400 {"field":"title"}; probe: POST with empty author returned 400 {"field":"author"}; missing author returned 400 {"field":"author"}; probe: GET /books after the rejections showed no new entries; app_server/templates/reading_list.html: the 400 handler shows '<field> must not be empty.' beside the field
  st-006  MET       tests/test_add_book.py: test_post_valid_book_is_listed_in_order_added, test_post_empty_title_returns_400_naming_title, test_post_empty_author_returns_400_naming_author; tests/test_list_books.py: test_get_books_lists_books_in_the_order_they_were_added; tests/test_remove_book.py: test_delete_stored_book_returns_204_with_empty_body, test_deleted_book_is_absent_from_next_list; governed_gate full: PASS

criteria.rationale: The governed gate `sh sources/full_test.sh` returned 0 and ran bin/test.sh, which runs the full pytest suite.
evidence: governed_gate full: PASS, return_code 0, stdout shows all dots with no failures
bin/test.sh:1-13 is a POSIX sh script that runs `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` and exits with its status
probe: n/a, pinned by the green governed gate

criteria.rationale: A POST with a title and author returned 201 and stored the book, and the list endpoint returned it; the page reloads the list after a 201.
evidence: app_server/books_views.py:23-30 POST /books calls add_book and returns 201 with id, title, author
probe: POST /books {Dune, Herbert} returned 201 with id 1; GET /books then returned it
app_server/templates/reading_list.html: on status 201 the script calls loadBooks(), which fetches /books and renders each entry

criteria.rationale: After adding three books, GET /books returned them in ascending id order, which is insertion order, and the order held after a deletion.
evidence: app_server/books_service.py:list_books sorts by id, the order added
probe: GET /books after adds returned ids 1, 2, 3 in order
probe: after DELETE of id 2, GET /books returned ids 1, 3 in order

criteria.rationale: DELETE /books/2 returned 204, and the next GET /books no longer included that book.
evidence: app_server/books_views.py:33-38 DELETE returns 204 on success
probe: DELETE /books/2 returned 204; following GET /books omitted id 2
probe: a second DELETE /books/2 returned 404, leaving the list unchanged

criteria.rationale: Empty or whitespace-only titles and authors, and missing authors, were rejected with 400 and the field name, and nothing was stored.
evidence: app_server/books_service.py:_required raises InvalidBook for empty or whitespace-only values
probe: POST with title '  ' returned 400 {"field":"title"}
probe: POST with empty author returned 400 {"field":"author"}; missing author returned 400 {"field":"author"}
probe: GET /books after the rejections showed no new entries
app_server/templates/reading_list.html: the 400 handler shows '<field> must not be empty.' beside the field

criteria.rationale: The suite has tests for adding, ordered listing, removal, and rejection of an empty title or author, and the green gate shows they run and pass.
evidence: tests/test_add_book.py: test_post_valid_book_is_listed_in_order_added, test_post_empty_title_returns_400_naming_title, test_post_empty_author_returns_400_naming_author
tests/test_list_books.py: test_get_books_lists_books_in_the_order_they_were_added
tests/test_remove_book.py: test_delete_stored_book_returns_204_with_empty_body, test_deleted_book_is_absent_from_next_list
governed_gate full: PASS

improvements: The 400 response carries only the field name ({"field":"title"}); the human-readable reason exists only in the page's JavaScript. Returning a message in the JSON body would make st-005's 'report the reason' observable at the API level.
Add a Sea Trial that the page's rendered list is updated after a removal, since that behavior is currently observed only by reading the template source.
